service.recyclarr: Keeps quality settings up to date

devui.title: UI components
wizard.welcome.title: Welcome to EasyArr
wizard.welcome.intro: EasyArr turns your Umbrel into your own streaming service. It sets up and connects a dozen media apps for you — no terminal, no config files. This setup takes about 10 minutes.
wizard.welcome.flow.request: You ask for a movie, show or album
wizard.welcome.flow.download: EasyArr finds and downloads it, always through a VPN
wizard.welcome.flow.sort: It's renamed, sorted and gets posters and subtitles
wizard.welcome.flow.watch: You watch it on your TV, phone or browser
wizard.welcome.legal: Only download content you have the right to download and share. Laws differ between countries — you are responsible for following the laws where you live.
wizard.system.title: Checking your Umbrel
wizard.system.intro: EasyArr runs many apps at once. Here's how well your Umbrel is suited.
wizard.account.title: Create your account
wizard.account.intro: This is the login you'll use to watch (Jellyfin) and to request new things (Jellyseerr).
wizard.download.title: How do you want to download?
wizard.download.intro: There are two ways to get movies and shows. Not sure? Start with torrents — you can change this later.
wizard.error.loadFailed: EasyArr couldn't load your setup progress. Check that the app is running, then try again.
wizard.error.saveFailed: Saving didn't work. Please try again.
wizard.error.network: EasyArr can't be reached right now. Check your connection to the Umbrel and try again.
wizard.error.previousSteps: Please finish the earlier steps first.
wizard.error.usernameInvalid: Use 2–32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
wizard.error.passwordWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Try a few random words, e.g. “purple-train-river”.
wizard.error.acknowledgeRequired: Please confirm that you want to continue anyway.
wizard.error.downloadMethodRequired: Please choose one of the options.
system.failed: The check didn't work. Try again in a moment.
system.summary.ok: Your Umbrel is ready for EasyArr.
system.summary.warning: EasyArr will work. Read the notes below.
system.summary.error: Your Umbrel may struggle to run EasyArr.
system.acknowledge: I understand that EasyArr may be slow or unstable on this Umbrel, and want to continue anyway.
system.arch.title: Processor
system.arch.unsupported: {{arch}} isn't supported. EasyArr's apps only exist for amd64 and arm64.
system.memory.title: Memory (RAM)
system.memory.low: {{gb}} GB — works, but your other Umbrel apps may get slower. 8 GB or more is best.
system.memory.tooLow: {{gb}} GB — not enough. EasyArr needs at least 4 GB, apps may crash or stall.
system.disk.title: Free space
system.disk.low: Only {{free}} free. Movies and shows are big — downloads stop when the disk is full.
system.disk.unknown: EasyArr couldn't read the free space. You can continue; keep an eye on it in Umbrel's settings.
system.gpu.title: Graphics (for video conversion)
system.gpu.dri: Found a graphics chip. Jellyfin can use it to convert videos quickly.
system.gpu.nvidia: Found an NVIDIA graphics card. Jellyfin can use it to convert videos quickly.
system.gpu.none: No graphics chip found. Jellyfin works, but converting high-quality video for some devices will be slow.
account.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A few random words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
account.passwordKeep: Your password is saved, but it isn't shown here for security reasons. Leave both fields empty to keep it, or type a new one to change it.
account.usedFor: You'll log in with this account in Jellyfin (watching) and Jellyseerr (requesting). The other apps are protected by your Umbrel login.
account.family: Accounts for family and friends are added later, once the setup is finished.
password.hint.common: this is a very common password
password.hint.variety: add numbers, capitals or symbols — or more words
download.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings.
download.torrents.title: Torrents
download.torrents.summary: Download from other people who share the same file.
download.torrents.con1: Speed depends on how many people share
download.torrents.con2: Needs a VPN (EasyArr sets it up next)
download.usenet.title: Usenet
download.usenet.summary: Download from paid servers, like from a normal website.
download.usenet.pro2: You don't share anything with others
download.usenet.con1: Costs a few euros/dollars a month
download.usenet.con2: Needs two accounts: a provider and an indexer
download.both.title: Both
download.both.summary: Use torrents and Usenet together and get whichever has it.
docs.title: Help
wizard.vpn.title: Protect your downloads with a VPN
wizard.vpn.intro: Downloads go through a VPN so your internet provider and other people only see the VPN, never your home address. Pick your VPN, follow the short guide, then press Connect.
wizard.vpn.skipNote: Not ready yet? You can skip this and add a VPN later in Settings — but until then, downloading stays switched off.
wizard.vpn.skipBody: EasyArr never downloads without a VPN. Until you connect one, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr and the download apps can't reach the internet, so nothing will download. Jellyfin and everything you already have keep working. Nothing leaks — downloads are blocked, not sent unprotected.
wizard.vpn.skipConfirm: Skip — I'll set it up later
wizard.error.vpnNotTested: Connect and pass the connection test first, or skip this step.
vpn.picker.noMatch: No provider matches. If yours isn't listed, use "Custom" with a WireGuard or OpenVPN file from your provider.
vpn.group.recommended.title: Best for torrents
vpn.group.recommended.body: These support port forwarding, which makes torrents faster and more reliable.
vpn.group.works.title: Also works
vpn.group.works.body: Safe and fine for Usenet; torrents work too, just slower without port forwarding.
vpn.group.custom.title: Custom
vpn.group.custom.body: Use a WireGuard (.conf) or OpenVPN (.ovpn) file from any provider.
vpn.protocol.label: Connection type
vpn.connecting.title: Connecting…
vpn.connecting.tunnel: Talking to your VPN provider. This usually takes under 30 seconds. ({{seconds}} s)
vpn.field.saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it, or paste a new one.
vpn.field.wgPrivateKey.label: WireGuard private key
vpn.field.wgPrivateKey.hint: 44 characters ending in "=". The guide shows where to find it.
vpn.field.wgPresharedKey.label: WireGuard preshared key
vpn.field.wgPresharedKey.hint: Only if your WireGuard file has a "PresharedKey" line.
vpn.field.wgAddresses.label: WireGuard address
vpn.field.wgAddresses.hint: The "Address" line from your WireGuard file, e.g. 10.64.222.21/32.
vpn.field.username.label: VPN username
vpn.field.username.hint: The OpenVPN / service username from the guide — often not your website login.
vpn.field.password.label: VPN password
vpn.field.password.hint: The OpenVPN / service password from the guide.
vpn.field.clientCert.label: Client certificate
vpn.field.clientCert.hint: Paste the text between <cert> and </cert> from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.clientKey.label: Client key
vpn.field.clientKey.hint: Paste the text between <key> and </key> from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.encryptedKey.label: Encrypted client key
vpn.field.encryptedKey.hint: The encrypted key block from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.keyPassphrase.label: Key passphrase
vpn.field.keyPassphrase.hint: The passphrase that unlocks the encrypted key.
vpn.field.wgConfig.label: WireGuard file (.conf)
vpn.field.wgConfig.hint: Paste the whole file or choose it below. It needs [Interface] and [Peer] sections.
vpn.field.ovpnConfig.label: OpenVPN file (.ovpn)
vpn.field.ovpnConfig.hint: Paste the whole file or choose it below.
vpn.freePlan.label: I use the free plan
vpn.freePlan.hint: Only free servers will be used. Free plans have no port forwarding.
vpn.pf.label: Port forwarding
vpn.pf.autoHint: Recommended for torrents. EasyArr asks your VPN for a port and sets it in qBittorrent automatically.
vpn.pf.staticHint: Reserve a port in your VPN account (see the guide) and enter it here. EasyArr sets it in qBittorrent.
vpn.result.homeUnknown: Couldn't double-check your home IP right now (that check needs the internet outside the VPN). The VPN itself is connected.
vpn.result.pfOff: Port forwarding is off — torrents work, just slower
vpn.result.pfWaiting: Waiting for your VPN to hand out a port…
vpn.problem.wrongKey.title: The key isn't right
vpn.problem.wrongKey.fix: The WireGuard key wasn't accepted. Copy it again from your VPN account — the whole key, with the "=" at the end and no spaces.
vpn.problem.authFailed.title: Username or password was refused
vpn.problem.authFailed.fix: Your VPN said no to the login. Most providers use special VPN credentials, not your website login — the guide shows where to find them. Also check your subscription is active.
vpn.problem.noServer.title: No server matches your choice
vpn.problem.noServer.fix: There's no server for this location with these options. Choose "Fastest / any", another location, or turn off port forwarding.
vpn.problem.invalidSettings.title: Something in the settings is missing or wrong
vpn.problem.invalidSettings.fix: Check every field against the guide and try again. The technical details below say which setting.
vpn.problem.certificate.title: The certificate or key wasn't accepted
vpn.problem.certificate.fix: Download a fresh config file from your VPN account and paste it again.
vpn.problem.unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the VPN server
vpn.problem.unreachable.fix: Your settings were accepted, but no connection came up. Try another location, or check your subscription. With WireGuard, a wrong key often looks like this too — copy it again.
vpn.problem.system.title: The VPN can't start on this device
vpn.problem.system.fix: The VPN part of EasyArr is missing a permission. Restart EasyArr from the Umbrel home screen; if it keeps happening, please report it.
vpn.problem.controlServer.title: The VPN isn't answering
vpn.problem.controlServer.fix: The VPN part of EasyArr started but doesn't answer. Press Test again in a minute, or restart EasyArr.
vpn.problem.vpnContainer.title: The VPN part of EasyArr isn't running
vpn.problem.vpnContainer.fix: Restart EasyArr from the Umbrel home screen (right-click → Restart) and try again.
vpn.problem.homeIpVisible.title: Your home IP is NOT hidden
vpn.problem.homeIpVisible.fix: The connection shows your real home address, so it is not protecting you. Check you picked the right provider and settings. Downloads stay blocked until this passes.
vpn.problem.unknown.title: The VPN didn't connect
vpn.problem.unknown.fix: Check your settings against the guide and try again. The technical details below may help.
vpn.error.load: Couldn't load your VPN settings. Reload the page to try again.
vpn.error.test: The connection test didn't finish. Check that EasyArr is running and try again.
vpn.error.invalidCharacters: This contains characters that can't be right — paste it again.
vpn.error.invalidCertificate: This doesn't look like a certificate or key. Copy the whole block again.
vpn.error.wgKey: A WireGuard key is 44 characters and ends with "=". Copy it again.
vpn.error.wgConfig: This doesn't look like a complete WireGuard file (it needs PrivateKey, Address, PublicKey and Endpoint).
vpn.error.ovpnConfig: This doesn't look like an OpenVPN file (no "remote" line).
vpn.error.endpointResolve: The server name in your file couldn't be found. Check your internet connection or use a file with an IP address.
vpn.error.location: Pick a location from the list.
vpn.error.freePlan: This provider has no free plan.
vpn.error.portForwarding: This provider has no port forwarding.
vpn.error.portForwardingFree: Free plans have no port forwarding.
vpn.error.provider: Pick a provider from the list.
vpn.error.protocol: This provider doesn't support that connection type.

wiring.note.deleted_by_user: "{{name}}" was deleted, so EasyArr left it out. Use "Repair connections" to put it back.
wiring.note.recreated: "{{name}}" was missing and has been put back.
wiring.note.adopted: "{{name}}" was already there — EasyArr uses it.
wiring.problem.jellyfinOtherAccount: Jellyfin was already set up with a different account. Sign in to Jellyfin and create a user with your EasyArr name and password (as administrator), then try again.
wiring.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
wiring.error.network: EasyArr isn't answering. Check that the app is running and try again.
wiring.error.wizard_incomplete: Finish the setup first (your account and how you download).
wiring.error.wiring_running: EasyArr is already connecting the apps. Wait a moment and look again.
wiring.error.internal: Something went wrong inside EasyArr. The log has the details.
home.problems: Some connections didn't work at the end of the setup. The rest works.
wizard.usenet.title: Your Usenet accounts
wizard.usenet.intro: Usenet needs two accounts: a provider that stores the files and an indexer that helps EasyArr find them. Enter both here — EasyArr sets up SABnzbd and Prowlarr for you.
wizard.indexers.title: Add search sites for torrents
wizard.indexers.intro: EasyArr searches torrent sites through Prowlarr. You choose which sites to use — EasyArr doesn't pick or recommend any. Follow the steps on the left, then come back here.
wizard.library.title: What do you want?
wizard.library.intro: Choose what you want to collect, your language and how much disk space to use. You can change all of this later.
wizard.finish.title: Connect everything
wizard.finish.intro: EasyArr now connects all the apps with your answers. This takes a minute or two — you can watch every step.
wizard.error.usenetHostRequired: Enter the server address from your provider.
wizard.error.usenetHostInvalid: Enter only the server name, like news.example.com — no https:// and no slashes.
wizard.error.usenetPortInvalid: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535 (usually 563).
wizard.error.usenetUsernameRequired: Enter the username from your provider.
wizard.error.usenetPasswordRequired: Enter the password from your provider.
wizard.error.usenetServerRequired: Add at least one Usenet provider.
wizard.error.indexerUrlInvalid: Enter the full address, starting with https://.
wizard.error.indexerApiKeyRequired: Enter the API key from the indexer's website.
wizard.error.noIndexers: Prowlarr has no search sites yet. Add one in Prowlarr first, or choose to do it later.
wizard.error.prowlarrUnreachable: Prowlarr isn't answering right now. Wait a moment and check again, or do this later.
wizard.error.libraryRequired: Choose at least one: movies, shows or music.
wizard.error.languageTwice: Each language can only be in the list once.
wizard.error.wiringNotDone: Connect the apps first (the button below).
usenet.explain.provider: A paid service (for example Newshosting or Eweka) that stores everything posted to Usenet. You get a server address, a username and a password.
usenet.explain.indexer: A search website (usually a small yearly fee) that knows where each movie or episode is. You get an address and an API key.
usenet.servers.title: Usenet provider
usenet.servers.intro: Pick your provider to fill in the server for you, then add your username and password. Have a second provider as a backup? Add it too.
usenet.servers.otherHint: Your provider's website lists the server address under "setup" or "newsreader settings".
usenet.servers.presetHint: Server details for {{name}} filled in. Connections is set for its smallest plan — a bigger plan may allow more (see your account).
usenet.servers.connectionsHint: How many downloads at once your plan allows. Too many makes the provider refuse you; fewer is just a bit slower.
usenet.indexers.title: Indexers
usenet.indexers.intro: Choose your indexer from the list or pick "Other" and enter its address. The API key is on the indexer's website, usually under your profile or "API".
usenet.indexers.presetHint: The list comes from Prowlarr. EasyArr doesn't recommend any of them.
usenet.indexers.name: Name
usenet.indexers.apiKeyHint: A long code from the indexer's website. It lets EasyArr search on your behalf.
usenet.savedHint: Your saved password isn't shown here for security reasons. Leave this empty to keep it.
usenet.testOptional: Testing is optional, but it saves you from surprises later. Tests go through your VPN, like real downloads.
usenet.test.result.auth: The username, password or API key was refused. Copy it again from your account and try once more.
usenet.test.result.unreachable: Couldn't reach this address. Check the server address and port for typos.
usenet.test.result.timeout: No answer in time. Check the port (usually 563 with SSL) and try again.
usenet.test.result.certificate: The encrypted connection didn't work. Check that SSL is on and the port is the SSL port (usually 563).
usenet.test.result.noVpn: Couldn't connect — and your VPN isn't connected. Tests (and downloads) only work through the VPN. Set up the VPN in step 5, then test again.
usenet.test.result.serviceDown: SABnzbd or Prowlarr isn't answering yet. Wait a minute and test again.
usenet.test.result.missingSecret: Enter the password or API key first.
usenet.test.result.failed: That didn't work. The message below says why.
indexers.step1: Open Prowlarr in a new tab.
indexers.step2: Add one or more search sites, following the steps on the left.
indexers.step3: Come back here — EasyArr notices them by itself, or press "Check again".
indexers.unreachable: Prowlarr isn't answering right now. It may still be starting — wait a moment and check again.
indexers.none: No search sites in Prowlarr yet.
indexers.vpnNote: Prowlarr tests each site when you add it. That only works with the VPN connected — if you skipped the VPN, do this step later.
indexers.laterBody: Without search sites, EasyArr can't find anything to download. Everything else gets set up now, and you can add sites in Prowlarr any time — EasyArr picks them up by itself.
library.libraries.title: What do you want to collect?
library.libraries.movies.title: Movies
library.libraries.tv.title: TV shows
library.libraries.tv.body: Sonarr follows shows and gets new episodes as they come out.
library.libraries.music.title: Music
library.libraries.music.body: Lidarr collects albums from the artists you like.
library.language.hint: Titles and descriptions in Jellyfin use your first subtitle language (or your first audio language if you don't want subtitles). This website itself stays in English.
library.audio.title: Audio: what you want to hear
library.audio.intro: Put the languages in order, best first. EasyArr goes for your first choice and takes the next one when the first isn't available.
library.audio.requiredHint: "Must have": a file needs at least one of these languages. If none of them is available, EasyArr asks you before downloading anything else. With no must-haves, any language is fine and the order just says what you prefer.
library.subtitles.title: Subtitles: what you want to read
library.subtitles.intro: Subtitles are fetched after a download by Bazarr, in this order. Leave the list empty if you don't want subtitles.
library.subtitles.requiredHint: "Must have": Bazarr keeps looking until it finds them, and the home screen tells you which movies and episodes are still missing them. Downloads don't wait for subtitles.
library.quality.title: Quality
library.quality.best.title: Best quality
library.quality.best.body: 4K when it exists, otherwise 1080p. Lossless music. For big screens and lots of storage.
library.quality.best.size: About 15–30 GB per movie, 4–12 GB per hour of TV, 300–600 MB per album.
library.quality.balanced.title: Balanced
library.quality.balanced.body: Sharp 1080p from good sources. Music in high-quality MP3/AAC, upgraded to lossless when available.
library.quality.balanced.size: About 6–15 GB per movie, 1.5–4 GB per hour of TV, 100–600 MB per album.
library.quality.small.title: Save space
library.quality.small.body: 1080p, preferring smaller files. High-quality MP3/AAC music. Good for phones, tablets and small disks.
library.quality.small.size: About 3–8 GB per movie, 1–2 GB per hour of TV, 80–150 MB per album.
library.quality.changeLater: Sizes are rough — they depend on the film. You can switch presets later; files you already have stay.
finish.summary.title: When you press the button, EasyArr will:
finish.summary.search: connect Prowlarr's search sites to Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr
finish.summary.library: create your libraries in Jellyfin with your account
finish.summary.requests: link the request page to Jellyfin, Sonarr and Radarr
finish.summary.time: Already set up something yourself? EasyArr keeps it and doesn't add duplicates.
finish.running: Connecting the apps… this can take a minute or two.
finish.failed: Some steps didn't work. Everything else is connected — fix what's listed below and try again.
finish.aiHelpSoon: A ready-made question for ChatGPT or Claude, with the details (no passwords) — arrives in a later update.
finish.anywayTitle: Finish with some steps not working?
finish.anywayBody: The apps that are connected work. What didn't work stays missing until you try again — you can do that any time from the home screen.
finish.done.title: Everything is connected
finish.done.body: Here's how you use it from now on:
finish.done.vpnSkipped: Downloads are still switched off because no VPN is connected. Set one up in step 5 to start downloading.
finish.done.indexersLater: Add at least one search site in Prowlarr — until then, EasyArr can't find anything.
finish.tour.request.title: Request
finish.tour.request.body: Open the request page, sign in with your EasyArr account and pick a movie or show.
finish.tour.download.title: Wait
finish.tour.download.body: EasyArr searches, downloads through the VPN, renames and sorts the files — nothing to do for you.
finish.tour.watch.title: Watch
finish.tour.watch.body: It appears in Jellyfin. Use the Jellyfin app on your TV, phone or browser with the same account.
wiring.problem.usenetSecretMissing: A password or API key is missing. Go back to the Usenet step, enter it again and save.
wiring.problem.recyclarr: Couldn't fetch the quality profiles from the TRaSH guides. That needs the internet through the VPN — check that the VPN is connected, then try again.
wiring.problem.prowlarrIndexer: Prowlarr couldn't add your indexer ({{details}}). Check the address and API key in the Usenet step, and that the VPN is connected.
wiring.problem.notAnswering: {{service}} isn't answering yet. It may still be starting (this can take a few minutes after an install or update) — try again in a moment.
wiring.problem.auth: {{service}} didn't accept EasyArr's login. Restarting EasyArr in the Umbrel app store usually fixes this.
wiring.problem.unexpected: {{service}} answered something EasyArr didn't expect. Try again; if it keeps happening, get help.
indexers.foundOne: Prowlarr has 1 search site. You're good to go.
indexers.foundMany: Prowlarr has {{count}} search sites. You're good to go.
finish.summary.downloaders.torrents: set up qBittorrent with folders for movies, shows and music
finish.summary.downloaders.usenet: set up SABnzbd with your Usenet provider
finish.summary.downloaders.both: set up qBittorrent and SABnzbd with your Usenet provider
dash.loadFailed: The dashboard couldn't load its status. Check that EasyArr is running, then try again.
dash.mode.label: Dashboard view
dash.watch.title: Watch
dash.watch.body: Movies, shows and music in Jellyfin
dash.request.title: Request
dash.request.body: Ask for something new to watch
dash.downloads.title: Downloads
dash.downloads.empty: Nothing is downloading right now. Request something and it shows up here.
dash.downloads.unreachable: The download apps aren't answering right now. If the VPN is down, they wait until it's back.
dash.recent.title: Recently added
dash.recent.empty: Nothing yet. New movies and shows appear here once they're ready to watch.
dash.recent.unavailable: Jellyfin isn't answering right now, so recent additions can't be shown.
dash.vpn.title: VPN details
dash.logs.title: Logs
dash.logs.unavailable: This app isn't answering, so its log can't be shown.
stuck.title: Needs your attention
stuck.language.body: Not available yet in the audio languages you need. There is a version in {{languages}} ({{quality}}, {{size}}).
stuck.quality.body: Only a lower quality exists so far: {{quality}} ({{size}}).
stuck.languageQuality.body: Not available yet in your languages or quality. There is a {{quality}} version in {{languages}} ({{size}}).
stuck.blocklisted.body: Every version found so far failed to download before, so EasyArr skips them.
stuck.nothingFound.body: Nothing found yet: your search sites have no usable version of this. EasyArr keeps looking by itself, season packs first, then episode by episode. Adding more search sites in Prowlarr helps most.
stuck.noSeeders.body: Versions exist, but nobody is sharing them right now.
stuck.downloadProblem.body: The download got stuck or couldn't be added to your library. The app says: "{{detail}}"
stuck.requestFailed.body: Your request didn't go through to the app that downloads it.
stuck.autoAccepted.body: Your first choice wasn't available, so EasyArr downloaded it in {{languages}} ({{quality}}). You turned this on in Settings → Advanced.
stuck.changed: Something changed since EasyArr last looked. Here's the new situation.
stuck.failed: That didn't work. The app didn't answer; try again in a minute.
dash.warning.title: Things that need your attention
dash.warning.vpnNotConfigured.title: The VPN isn't set up
dash.warning.vpnNotConfigured.body: Downloads stay paused until a VPN is set up, so your home IP is never visible.
dash.warning.vpnDown.title: The VPN isn't connected
dash.warning.vpnDown.body: Downloads and searches are paused until it reconnects. Nothing goes out without the VPN.
dash.warning.diskLow.title: Storage is almost full
dash.warning.diskLow.body: Only {{percent}} % free. Delete things you've watched, or downloads will stop when it's full.
dash.warning.serviceDown.title: Not answering: {{services}}
dash.warning.serviceDown.body: It may still be starting. If this stays for more than a few minutes, restart EasyArr in the Umbrel app list.
dash.warning.officialJellyfin.title: Two Jellyfins are installed
dash.warning.officialJellyfin.body: The Jellyfin app from the Umbrel App Store is installed too. EasyArr's downloads only show up in EasyArr's Jellyfin (port 39096).
dash.warning.updateAvailable.title: Update available: EasyArr {{version}}
dash.warning.updateAvailable.body: Install it from the Umbrel App Store (Updates). Your settings and media are kept.
dash.warning.wiringProblems.title: Some connections didn't work
dash.warning.indexersDown.title: Search sites can't be reached
dash.warning.indexersDown.body: None of your search sites answer through the VPN right now, so new requests can't find anything. EasyArr tries again every 5 minutes. If this lasts for hours, pick another VPN server country.
dash.warning.subtitlesMissing.title: {{languages}} subtitles still missing
dash.warning.subtitlesMissing.body_one: Bazarr hasn't found them yet for {{names}}. It keeps looking by itself; new subtitles often appear a few days after a release.
dash.warning.subtitlesMissing.body_other: Bazarr hasn't found them yet for {{count}} items ({{names}}…). It keeps looking by itself; new subtitles often appear a few days after a release.
dash.warning.wiringProblems.body: The last setup run had problems. Repairing tries again and explains what's wrong.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pick: Pick what you want to change on the left.
settings.apply.applying: Saved. Applying the change to all apps…
settings.apply.done: Done. Everything uses the new setting now.
settings.apply.failed: Saved, but some apps couldn't be updated. The list below says what went wrong. You can repair it under Advanced.
settings.account.body: This account signs you in to Jellyfin and the request page. Changing the password from here will come in a later update. For now, change it in Jellyfin (your profile → Password).
settings.advanced.body: EasyArr connects all apps for you. If something stopped working, run it again. "Repair" also brings back connections that were deleted by hand.
settings.advanced.repairHint: Repair puts back things EasyArr created that you deleted in Sonarr, Radarr & co. Your own changes stay as they are.
settings.recheck.label: Look again for things that haven't downloaded
settings.recheck.hint: If nothing was found when you asked for a movie or episode, EasyArr asks Sonarr and Radarr to search again on this schedule. It searches a few at a time so your search sites don't block you.
settings.recheck.failed: Couldn't save this setting. Try again.
settings.autoAccept.label: Accept alternatives automatically
settings.autoAccept.hint: When your languages or quality aren't available, download the best other version without asking. Off: EasyArr shows it under "Needs your OK" on the home screen and waits for you.
settings.autoAccept.failed: Couldn't save this setting. Try again.
settings.about.body: EasyArr is free and open source. Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us on GitHub.
backup.intro: This backs up your setup, not your movies: your answers, accounts, VPN, connections, and the history and settings of Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr and Jellyfin. Your media files and anything still downloading are not included.
backup.download.title: Download a backup
backup.download.encryptHint: The file holds your VPN key and passwords. With a password, nobody who gets the file can read them. Keep the password somewhere safe: without it the backup can't be restored.
backup.download.plainHint: Without a password, anyone who gets this file can read your VPN key and passwords. Only do this if you keep the file somewhere private.
backup.download.slow: This can take a minute: each app makes its own backup first.
backup.auto.title: Automatic backups
backup.auto.whereNote: Automatic backups stay on your Umbrel, in Files → EasyArr → backups, without a password. To keep a copy somewhere else, download one there or above.
backup.auto.lastFailed: The automatic backup on {{date}} didn't work: {{error}}
backup.files.none: No automatic backups yet. The first one is made at the time above.
backup.files.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted from your Umbrel. This can't be undone.
backup.restore.title: Restore from a backup
backup.restore.intro: Brings back a setup from an EasyArr backup file, for example after reinstalling EasyArr.
backup.restore.pageIntro: Choose an EasyArr backup (a file ending in .easyarr). You'll see what's inside before anything changes.
backup.restore.chooseHint: Automatic backups are in Files → EasyArr → backups on your Umbrel. Download one there first, or restore it from Settings → Backups.
backup.restore.locked: This backup is protected with a password.
backup.restore.withHistory: Comes back as it was, with history: {{apps}}.
backup.restore.settingsOnly: Your answers, accounts and VPN come back; the apps are set up again from them.
backup.restore.rebuilt: Set up again from your answers: qBittorrent, SABnzbd, Bazarr, Jellyseerr and the helpers. Past requests in Jellyseerr aren't kept.
backup.restore.notIncluded: Not in any backup: your media files and unfinished downloads.
backup.restore.skipped: When this backup was made, these apps couldn't make their own backup and will be set up again from your answers: {{apps}}.
backup.restore.unfinished: The setup in this backup wasn't finished. The wizard continues where it left off.
backup.restore.replaces: Your current EasyArr settings are replaced by the ones in the backup.
backup.restore.confirmBody: Your current settings are replaced. The apps restart while this runs, which takes a few minutes. Keep this page open to follow along.
backup.progress.title: Restore
backup.progress.step.easyarr: Your answers, accounts and VPN settings
backup.progress.step.wiring: Setting up and checking all apps
backup.progress.note.fallback: {{app}} couldn't take its own backup, so it was set up again from your answers. Its history from the backup is missing.
backup.progress.note.vpn_failed: The VPN didn't connect. Check it in Settings → VPN; searches and downloads wait until it works.
backup.progress.note.vpn_skipped: No VPN in this backup. Set one up in Settings → VPN before downloading.
backup.progress.note.wiring_problems: Some connections need attention. "Repair connections" in Settings → Advanced shows what and fixes most problems.
backup.progress.problems: The restore finished, but not everything worked. The steps above say what's missing.
backup.error.network: EasyArr didn't answer. Check that it's running and try again.
backup.error.not_a_backup: This isn't an EasyArr backup. Choose a file ending in .easyarr.
backup.error.corrupted: This backup file is damaged and can't be restored. Try another copy.
backup.error.password_required: This backup is protected. Enter its password.
backup.error.wrong_password: That password doesn't open this backup. Check it and try again.
backup.error.newer_format: This backup was made by a newer version of EasyArr. Update EasyArr in the Umbrel App Store, then try again.
backup.error.backup_running: A backup is being made right now. Try again in a minute.
backup.error.wiring_running: EasyArr is setting up the apps right now. Try again in a minute.
backup.error.invalid: Something in the request wasn't accepted. Reload the page and try again.
backup.error.internal: Something went wrong inside EasyArr. The details are in EasyArr's log.
backup.error.bad_request: The file is too big or couldn't be sent. Try again.
stuck.subtitle_one: One request hasn't arrived yet. Here's why, and what you can do.
stuck.subtitle_other: {{count}} requests haven't arrived yet. Here's why, and what you can do.
dash.apps.unused_one: {{count}} app not used by your setup
dash.apps.unused_other: {{count}} apps not used by your setup
dash.apps.noWindow: This app has no window of its own; EasyArr runs it for you.
